description: This PHP source file defines a database migration class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 4.8.0. It contains methods to insert and update configuration data related to help URLs and processors, as well as to create internationalization groups.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class for updating configurations and database schema related to version 4.8.0 of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes migration actions: inserts help URL, help processor class, and creates an internationalization group.

methods.name: insertConfig
methods.description: Inserts a configuration key-value pair into the 'hs_hr_config' table.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number of the migration ('4.8').

methods.name: updateConfig
methods.description: Updates an existing configuration value in the 'hs_hr_config' table.
